title: The in-run go gate skips every end-to-end classification and mass-routing test (-short)
body: The gate runs go test -short, and 7 of the 10 tests exercising epic wne's exchange and routing (the four end-to-end classify_test.go exchange tests and the three tier_test.go mass-routing tests) skip under -short; only three pure record-parsing tests ran at each tick's gate. They pass in a full run (verified in review), but per-tick gates went green without exercising the change. Either give the gate a non-short run of the packages a tick touched, or make these fixture tests cheap enough not to skip.
